metadata.title: Nasdaq Futures Rise After Asian Indexes Slump in Global Market Selloff - WSJ

content.text:
The AI trade has for now stopped spiraling, after a bruising selloff that set back the Nasdaq by about $2.5 trillion yesterday.
The tech-heavy index is gaining more than 1%, reversing some of Thursday’s historic losses. The Dow, on the other hand, is about flat on the day after paring morning losses.
